temporaryWallet.offerTitle: No Ethereum wallet? Use a temporary one
temporaryWallet.offerText: It is made on this page and lasts until you close the tab. MoonPay sends your ETH to it, and you approve each next step here.
temporaryWallet.backupText: This wallet exists only in this browser tab. If the tab closes before your money reaches SORA, these 12 words are the only way to get it back.
temporaryWallet.privateWarning: Anyone with these words can take the money in this wallet. Do not share them.
temporaryWallet.restoreText: Enter the recovery phrase of a temporary wallet you made on this page.
temporaryWallet.restoreWarning: Do not enter the recovery phrase of your main wallet here.
temporaryWallet.invalidPhrase: These words are not a valid recovery phrase. Check the spelling and the order.
temporaryWallet.openTitle: Your temporary wallet is still open
temporaryWallet.closeWarning: This wallet still holds {amount}. Without the recovery phrase, that money is lost when you close it.
temporaryWallet.closeWarningUnknown: The balance could not be checked. If money is left in this wallet, you need the recovery phrase to get it back.
temporaryWallet.connectFailed: The temporary wallet could not connect. Try again.
temporaryWallet.keepPageOpen: You are using a temporary wallet. Keep this page open until your transfer to SORA is sent. If the page closes, restore the wallet with its recovery phrase.
temporaryWallet.leftover: Some ETH is usually left over after network fees. It stays in this wallet. To use it later, import the recovery phrase into any Ethereum wallet app.

file.title: Polkaswap temporary Ethereum wallet
file.help: To open this wallet later, import the recovery phrase into an Ethereum wallet app such as MetaMask, or use Restore a temporary wallet on the Polkaswap Buy XOR page.

request.title: Temporary wallet
request.convert: Swap {amount} ETH for at least {minimum} DAI
request.allowBridge: Let the SORA bridge move {amount} DAI
request.allowBridgeAll: Let the SORA bridge move any amount of DAI from this wallet
request.otherSoraAccount: This SORA account is not the one connected to Polkaswap. Approve only if you meant to send to it.
request.feeIncreased: Network fees went up. Check the new fee, then approve again.
request.note: Nothing is sent until you approve.
